description: This file implements the SharedStorageImplementation class, which manages shared storage operations, including registration, configuration, value setting/getting, deletion, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: Implements shared storage management, including registration, configuration, value operations, event dispatching, and resource cleanup within the WPEFramework plugin system.

methods.name: SharedStorageImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal members and logging creation.

methods.name: ~SharedStorageImplementation
methods.description: Destructor releasing resources and cleaning up.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton-like method to get or set the shared instance of SharedStorageImplementation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for shared storage events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the shared storage with the provided service, querying necessary interfaces.

methods.name: getRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Returns the appropriate remote store object based on the scope.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Dispatches a value changed event to registered notifications.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Submits an event job to the worker pool for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes registered notifications with the event and parameters.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the shared storage for a given scope, namespace, and key.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL from shared storage for a given scope, namespace, and key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from shared storage.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves keys within a namespace for device scope.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespaces for device scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage size information for device scope.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace within device scope.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace within device scope.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes the cache of the shared storage.
